sources.snippet: Responsible AI Development Black Forest Labs is committed to responsible model development and deployment. Prior to releasing FLUX 3 Image Klein, we evaluated and mitigated a number of risks, including child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and nonconsensual intimate imagery (NCII).

sources.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein in ComfyUI: Text-to-Image and Edit
sources.snippet: About FLUX.3 [klein] FLUX.3 [klein] is Black Forest Labs' open-weights FLUX.3 image model for local ComfyUI: text-to-image and instruction-driven image editing in one family, with a full checkpoint and a step-distilled variant for faster 4-16 step runs. Weights ship on Hugging Face under the FLUX Kommunity License.

sources.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein Launch | Comfy
sources.snippet: Is FLUX 3 Image Klein the same as the FLUX 3 Image Partner Node in ComfyUI? No. The FLUX 3 Image Partner Node calls Black Forest Labs' hosted API and runs the larger FLUX 3 Image model. FLUX 3 Image Klein is the open-weights model you download and run yourself, locally or on Comfy Cloud. Both are available in ComfyUI.

sources.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein in ComfyUI: 5.6B Open Weights - by Rob
sources.snippet: FLUX 3 Image Klein is the compact, open-weights model in Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 family. It draws on learning shared across the family's image, video, and audio models, and it keeps the control features of the larger FLUX 3 Image model, bounding boxes included.
